trade insults: The two players began to trade insults on the court until the referee stepped in and stopped them.
兩名球員在球場上開始互相辱罵，直到裁判介入阻止了他們。
trade places: You think my job is easy, but you would not want to trade places with me for even one day.
你以為我的工作很輕鬆，但你連一天都不會想和我交換位置。
trade in a car: My father decided to trade in a car he had driven for fifteen years for a new electric one.
我爸爸決定把開了十五年的舊車拿去舊車換新，換一台新的電動車。
trade on one's reputation: The singer has not released a good song in ten years and now just tries to trade on her reputation.
那位歌手十年來沒有發過一首好歌，現在只是想靠她的名聲牟利。
trade off: When choosing a new phone, many students have to trade off price against quality and battery life.
選新手機時，許多學生必須在價格與品質和電池續航力之間權衡取捨。
trade blows: The two drunk men started to trade blows outside the bar, and someone quickly called the police.
兩名喝醉的男子在酒吧外開始互毆，有人很快就報了警。
trade secrets: The engineer was fired after he sold the company's trade secrets to a rival company in another country.
那名工程師把公司的商業機密賣給另一國的競爭公司後被開除了。
trail behind: The youngest hiker was tired and began to trail behind the rest of the group on the steep mountain path.
最年輕的登山客累了，在陡峭的山路上開始落後於隊伍其他人。
trail off: Her voice began to trail off at the end of the sentence, and she looked down at the floor nervously.
她的聲音在句尾漸漸變弱，然後緊張地低頭看著地板。
trail a suspect: The detectives had to trail a suspect for three days before they finally found where the stolen jewels were hidden.
警探們尾隨嫌犯三天，最後才找到被偷的珠寶藏在哪裡。
trail by two points: With only ten seconds left in the game, our team continued to trail by two points and needed one more basket.
比賽只剩十秒，我們隊仍落後兩分，還需要再進一球。
blaze a trail: As the first woman to fly across the ocean alone, she helped blaze a trail for female pilots everywhere.
身為第一位獨自飛越海洋的女性，她為各地的女性飛行員開了路。
on the trail of: The police are now on the trail of the thieves who broke into the jewelry store last night.
警方正在追蹤昨晚闖入珠寶店的竊賊。
train one's eyes on: The cat sat still under the tree and seemed to train its eyes on the small bird above it.
那隻貓靜靜地坐在樹下，似乎緊盯著上方那隻小鳥。
train a dog: It takes a lot of patience to train a dog to sit and wait quietly before it eats.
要訓練狗在吃東西前坐下並安靜等待，需要很大的耐心。
train as a nurse: My sister decided to train as a nurse at a medical college for three years before she got her first hospital job.
我姊姊決定在醫學院受訓三年成為護士，之後才得到她第一份醫院工作。
train hard: Our coach makes us train hard with heavy weights three times a week before the national competition.
全國比賽前，我們教練要我們每週三次用重物刻苦訓練。
train a gun on: The soldier stood by the window, ready to train a gun on the door if anyone tried to come in.
士兵站在窗邊，準備在有人試圖進來時用槍瞄準門口。
a train of thought: The phone rang in the middle of my essay, and the noise completely broke a train of thought I had been following.
寫作文寫到一半電話響了，鈴聲完全打斷了我原本的思路。
transfer money: You can now transfer money to your friends with a mobile app in just a few seconds.
現在你只要用手機應用程式，幾秒鐘就能轉帳給朋友。
transfer to another school: After his family moved to Kaohsiung, Kevin had to transfer to another school in the middle of the semester.
凱文的家人搬到高雄後，他必須在學期中轉學到另一所學校。
transfer skills: Good students know how to transfer skills such as teamwork and problem solving from the classroom to real jobs.
好學生懂得把團隊合作和解決問題等技能從教室轉移到真實工作中。
transfer power: After the election, the old president agreed to transfer power peacefully to the new leader.
選舉過後，前任總統同意和平地把權力移交給新領導人。
transfer a call: Please hold on while I transfer a call from the front desk to the manager's office.
請稍候，我把電話從櫃台轉接到經理辦公室。
transfer ownership: Before you sell your scooter, you must go to the office to transfer ownership to the new buyer.
賣掉機車之前，你必須到監理單位把所有權轉讓給新買家。
be transferred to: My uncle will be transferred to the company's Tainan office next month, so his whole family is moving south.
我叔叔下個月會被調到公司的台南辦公室，所以他全家都要搬到南部。
transform the economy: The government hopes new technology will transform the economy from farming to high-tech industry within twenty years.
政府希望新科技能在二十年內改造經濟，從農業轉型為高科技產業。
transform one's life: Learning to read at the age of sixty helped transform her life and opened many new doors for her.
六十歲時學會識字改變了她的人生，為她開啟了許多新的大門。
transform into a butterfly: Inside the cocoon, the caterpillar's body completely changes shape and will transform into a butterfly in two weeks.
在繭裡，毛毛蟲的身體會徹底改變形狀，並在兩週內變成蝴蝶。
transform the landscape: The new highway and tall apartment buildings will transform the landscape of this quiet farming town.
新的高速公路和高聳的公寓大樓將會改變這座寧靜農村小鎮的地貌。
a transforming experience: Volunteering in Africa was a transforming experience; she came back home a completely different person with new goals.
到非洲當志工是一次脫胎換骨的經驗；她回家時變成了一個有著新目標、截然不同的人。
